iss_host_station.name: International Space Station
iss_host_station.role: Existing host spacecraft; dimensions are published reference specifications for geometry and labels
caveats: These dimensions have distinct geometric definitions; 109 m is a span, not a radius.
The reference mass is not a measured mass for the 2016, 2017 or November 2026 telemetry dates. Visiting vehicles change station mass and configuration.
NASA also lists a 51 m PMA2-to-Service-Module extent, which is a different boundary definition from the 67 m module major axis.
No whole-station CAD model, inertia tensor or motor-command training labels are supplied here.

mars_s_mhu1_mhu2.name: JAXA Multiple Artificial-gravity Research System, short-arm configuration (MARS-S)
mars_s_mhu1_mhu2.host: ISS Kibo Centrifuge-equipped Biological Experiment Facility (CBEF)
mars_s_mhu1_mhu2.radius_role: Verified configuration metadata; fixed for this experiment, not a learned input
mars_s_mhu1_mhu2.program_status: MHU-1/MHU-2 completed; later MHU-8/9 listed in analysis and MHU-10/11 in preparation. Continuing program does not establish that this rotor is spinning today.
mars_s_mhu1_mhu2.caveat: Same published radius and speed setting across two missions; not proof of identical control software or all hardware revisions.

iss_mams.name: NASA Microgravity Acceleration Measurement System (MAMS)
iss_mams.caveat: Separate date, measurement location and data product from MARS. It must not be combined with the centrifuge logs as simultaneous, co-located measurements.
